_about: The single source of truth for this platform: what it accepts and what we have learned about it. Every skill, job and script that makes or posts videos for it reads this file; put new findings here, not anywhere else. maxSeconds is the platform's limit. A video longer than that never goes out cut: the video build makes a separate version for this platform of at most versionSeconds, with its own hook, payoff and end card (data.versions.<platform>), and the publisher posts it only when that version exists.

metadata.title: At most 70 characters (YouTube allows 100): the claim first with the main noun of the card's `search` phrase in it, ending in " #shorts". No "in 60 Seconds".
metadata.text: 2-3 plain sentences, the first holding the card's `search` phrase (How To Hero cards; verbatim when it reads as a clause, like "why is the sea salty", otherwise all its words in natural order): what the video shows and one extra fact, then "Sources: <names>", then 3 hashtags. No @handles (they are Instagram handles).

notes: The description limit is 5000 UTF-8 bytes, not characters: English takes 1 byte a letter, Telugu 3, emoji 4, so a Telugu description holds about 1,600 letters. Titles are 100 characters. Neither may contain < or >. The limits mirror Social Media Publisher, which refuses a post over them ({"action":"platforms"} returns its numbers); the publish script trims only as a last resort and warns, so write within them.
Shorts up to 3 minutes; documentaries are 16:9 long-form and are never cut.
API uploads go out public (since 2026-11-16; Google confirmed API uploads are not forced private).
Upload quota is about 6 videos a day by the old estimate, reset at 13:30 IST; in practice 9 uploads on 16 Nov 2026 all went through.

Posting times (IST) are the same 5 as Instagram (one publish run posts to every platform); see the reasoning in instagram.json. India Shorts guides (Fluxnote) also name 7-9 AM and 7-9 PM IST. 5 uploads a day fit the quota: 9 uploads on 16 Nov 2026 all succeeded.

Custom thumbnails work on Shorts through the API (thumbnails.set): tested 19 Nov 2026 on hWIIk9FVSJ8, no warning, and i.ytimg.com serves the new image, so the channel is verified for custom thumbnails. Shorts feed viewers never see it (the video autoplays); search, the Shorts tab, subscriptions and suggested do. The publisher sends data.thumb (rules in the skill's THUMBNAILS.md). Each call costs about 50 quota units.

Custom thumbnails need the channel's Intermediate features Enabled (phone verification, per channel, not per Google account). A new channel answers 403 on thumbnails.set until then; the video still posts with a warning. Checklist: SETUP.md 'Before a new YouTube channel posts anything'.

anaadi._about: Serialized channel (Anaadi, Telugu mythology). Its Inbox cards carry data.channel "anaadi" and data.episode. The publisher uploads them to YouTube account "anaadi" strictly in episode order, one per run, each scheduled with YouTube's own publish time: one episode every everyDays days at timeIST, after the latest one already scheduled. A missing or failed episode holds every later one. 'after' is the last episode scheduled outside the publisher; raise it if you schedule one by hand. crossLink is a line added to each new description that points to the sister channel (Shorts have no end screens, and the related-video link has no API).
anaadi.crossLink: 🪔 ఇంట్లో పిల్లల కోసం శ్లోకాలు · Slokas for the children at home: https://www.youtube.com/@ChinniSlokalu
anaadi._groups: Categories on the channel. A card names its group in data.group; no data.group means the main group above ('saga', Mahagatha: the continuous story, one playlist per season). Every group numbers its own episodes from 1 (data.episode), posts in that order at its own timeIST every everyDays, and fills its own playlist. A card with an unknown group never posts.

lokas._about: Lokalu: the worlds of the Puranas (14 lokas, Bhu Mandala, Meru, Vaikuntha, Kailasa...).
lokas.playlist: లోకాలు · Lokas: Worlds of the Puranas

divya._about: Divya Sampada: divine weapons, vahanas and treasures (Sudarshana, Vajra, Garuda, Airavata, Kamadhenu, Kaustubha...).

thelastsignal._about: Serialized channel (The Last Signal, wordless stickman animation, @TheLastSignalAnimated). Its Inbox cards carry data.app "The Last Signal", data.channel "thelastsignal" and data.episode. Same rules as anaadi: strict episode order, one every everyDays days at timeIST after the latest scheduled one. Episode 1 was scheduled by hand in YouTube Studio.
thelastsignal._groups: One group for now: the main story. Add a group here if Shorts or a second season ever post through the publisher.
